```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Objective
Separate tissue fragments in whole slide images.
The objective of this model is to generate polygons around separate tissue fragments, and label 
fragments for inclusion or as duplicates.

## Parameters
All parameters were set by testing out different settings in a training set "labl_2020_training_1" and 
for some adjusting them based on visual assessments in the tuning set "labl_2020_tuning".
- **tolerance_value**
Sets how much the original polygons are simplified (simplifies compute)
- **merge_buffer_um**
The first step in generating fragments is merging tissue polygons within (double)
this distance from each other
- **separate_buffer_um**
The second step in generating fragments is "shrinking" the polygons by this much
to release touching fragments from each other (only works if touching interface is small)
- **min_area_um2**
The third step is filtering out fragments below this threshold
- **expand_buffer_um**
The fourth step is expanding each fragment polygon (to regain peripheral areas lost 
in step 2)
- **set_buffer_um**
The fifth step is to identify sets of fragment by merging multiple fragments
within thid distance of each other together
- **similarity_threshold**
The sixth step is to label sets of fragments that are above this threshold in similarity
to each other as duplicates, exlude the smallest of them and label all fragments in that
set as duplicate_fragments and all other fragments for inclusion


#### Input
- fragments_metadata.json (fe_si_models/fragments/output/fragments)
file to keep track of all previously processed fragments
- subset_<subset_name>.json (fe_si_images/output/process_subset/)
- <image>_tissue_1.geojson (fe_si_models/tissue_vs_glass/output/export_tissue/)

#### Output
- <image_name>_fragments.geojson (fe_si_models/fragments/output/fragments)
with fragment coordinates
- fragment_metadata_<subset>.json (fe_si_models/fragments/output/fragments)
- template_fragments_<subset>.json (fe_si_models/fragments/output/fragments)
for human-in-the-loop to correct duplicates and mark fragments for exclusion
- <subset>_processed_fragments.txt (fe_si_models/fragments/output/fragments)
to read into qupath for human-in-the-loop assessment
  
## Issues / Deviations
- fragments with a large area touching the neighboring fragments are merged to one
(unable to find optimal settings for merge_buffer_um and separate_buffer_um to work for 
all instances.  These could possibly be filtered based on size 
but after merging with villi/crypts probably.
-  duplicate fragment sets that are unusually close to each other are not identified 
as separate fragment sets and thus not excluded. Prioritized not "overcalling" duplicates
when setting these parameters to not loose fragments.
- rarely the simplification causes invalid outputs - in cases this happen I have added error checks that instead processed the unsimplified tissue


```{r libraries, directories, functions, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(sf)
library(writexl)
Sys.setenv(OGR_GEOJSON_MAX_OBJ_SIZE = 0)
library(nngeo) #remove holes in outline
options(scipen = 999) #turn of scientific notation

#to_box <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/"
to_box <- "C:/Users/15303/Box/"

generate_fragments <- function(subset,
                               tissue_dir,
                               fragment_dir,
                               tolerance_value = 150,
                               merge_buffer_um = 35,
                               separate_buffer_um = 25,
                               min_area_um2 = 500000,
                               expand_buffer_um = 100,
                               set_buffer_um = 2320,
                               similarity_threshold = 0.70
                               ) {
  
  
  checkpoint_file <- file.path(fragment_dir, "subset_fragment_metadata_checkpoint.rds")
  
  log_meta <- function(df){
    subset_fragment_metadata <<- bind_rows(subset_fragment_metadata, df)
    saveRDS(subset_fragment_metadata, checkpoint_file)
  }
  
  
  subset_fragment_metadata <-
    if(file.exists(checkpoint_file)) readRDS(checkpoint_file) else NULL
  
  log_file <- file.path(fragment_dir, "simplify_errors.csv")
  if (!file.exists(log_file)) {
    readr::write_csv(
      tibble::tibble(time   = character(),
                     image  = character(),
                     stage  = character(),
                     err    = character()),
      log_file
    )
  }
  
  safe_step <- function(expr, stage, img) {
    tryCatch(
      expr,
      error = function(e) {
        # 2a) append to the csv log  
        readr::write_csv(
          tibble::tibble(
            time  = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
            image = img,
            stage = stage,
            err   = e$message
            ),
          log_file,
          append = TRUE
          )
        message("❌  ", img, " failed at ", stage, " (", e$message, ")")
        return(NULL)
      }
    )
  }
  
  
  for (row in 1:nrow(subset)) {
    
    image_name <- subset$image_name[row]
    
    print(paste0("Processing image ", image_name))
    
    pixel_length_um <- subset$pixel_length_um[row]
    pixel_area_um2 <- subset$pixel_area_um2[row]
    
    #transform parameters from um to px
    merge_buffer_px <- merge_buffer_um / pixel_length_um
    separate_buffer_px <- separate_buffer_um / pixel_length_um
    min_area_px2 <- min_area_um2 / pixel_area_um2
    expand_buffer_px <- expand_buffer_um / pixel_length_um
    set_buffer_px <- set_buffer_um / pixel_length_um
    
    #read in tissue coordinates (from tissue_vs_glass model)
    coordinate_file_name <- paste0(image_name, "_tissue_1.geojson")
    coordinate_file_path <- file.path(tissue_dir, coordinate_file_name)
    
    if (!file.exists(coordinate_file_path)) {
      warning(paste("File not found:", coordinate_file_path))
      next
    }
    
    tissue <- st_read(coordinate_file_path, quiet = TRUE) %>%
      st_set_crs(0)
    
    if (!st_is_valid(tissue)) {
      message("⚠️  ", image_name, " has invalid geometry, running st_make_valid()")
      tissue <- st_make_valid(tissue)
    }
    
    if (!st_is_valid(tissue)) {
      print(st_is_valid_reason(tissue))
      # skip the slide but keep the loop running
      next 
    }
    
    tissue_noholes <- safe_step(
      tissue %>% st_remove_holes(),
      stage = "st_remove_holes",
      img   = image_name
      )
    if (is.null(tissue_noholes)) next 
    
    tissue_simplified <- safe_step(
      tissue_noholes %>%
        st_make_valid() %>%
        st_simplify(dTolerance = tolerance_value) %>%
        st_make_valid(),
      stage = "st_simplify",
      img   = image_name
      )
    
    if (is.null(tissue_simplified)) {
    # fall back: use the *unsimplified* version and keep going
      tissue_simplified <- tissue_noholes
      }

  
    preliminary_fragment <- st_buffer(tissue_simplified, dist = merge_buffer_px) %>%
      st_make_valid() %>% 
      st_buffer(dist = -separate_buffer_px) %>%
      st_make_valid() %>% 
      st_cast("POLYGON") %>%
      st_make_valid() %>% 
      st_as_sf() %>%
      mutate(
        image_name = image_name,
        fragment_area_px2 = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)),
        fragment_area_um2 = fragment_area_px2 * pixel_area_um2
      ) %>%
      arrange(desc(fragment_area_um2)) %>%
      mutate(
        name = sprintf("%02d", row_number()),
        classification = "fragments"
      )
    
    #Filter out small fragments
    filtered_preliminary_fragments <- preliminary_fragment %>%
      filter(fragment_area_um2 > min_area_um2)
    
    fragments <- filtered_preliminary_fragments %>%
      st_buffer(dist = expand_buffer_px)
    
    safe_union <- function(x) {
      tryCatch(st_union(x), error = function(e) {
        message("GEOS error on union for ", image_name, ": ", e$message)
        st_make_valid(st_union(st_make_valid(x)))
      })
    }
    
    fragments_united <- fragments %>% safe_union() %>% st_remove_holes()
  
    
    fragment_sets <- st_buffer(fragments_united, dist = set_buffer_px) %>%
      st_cast('POLYGON') %>%
      st_as_sf() %>%
      rename(geometry = x) %>%
      mutate(image_name = image_name,
             fragment_set_area_um2 = st_area(geometry) * pixel_area_um2) %>%
      arrange(desc(fragment_set_area_um2)) %>%
      mutate(name = sprintf("%02d", row_number()),
             classification = "fragment_set") %>%
      select(image_name, name, classification, fragment_set_area_um2, geometry)
    
    # Check for duplicates (similar in size) and mark for include T/F based on size in duplicate set
    similarity_function <- function(a, b) {pmin(a, b) / pmax(a, b)}
    similarity_threshold <- similarity_threshold
    
    if (nrow(fragment_sets) < 2) {
      comparison_df <- data.frame(
        image_name = image_name,
        fragment_1 = fragment_sets$name[1],
        fragment_2 = NA,
        fragment_pair = NA,
        area1 = NA,
        area2 = NA,
        similarity = NA,
        duplicates = FALSE,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      
      fragment_sets <- fragment_sets %>%
      mutate(include = TRUE,
             classification = "include_set")
      } else {
        combos <- t(combn(seq_len(nrow(fragment_sets)), 2))
        comparison_df <- data.frame(
          fragment_1 = fragment_sets$name[combos[, 1]],
          fragment_2 = fragment_sets$name[combos[, 2]]
          ) %>%
          mutate(
            image_name = image_name,
            fragment_pair = paste0(fragment_1, "_vs_", fragment_2),
            area1 = fragment_sets$fragment_set_area_um2[match(fragment_1, fragment_sets$name)],
            area2 = fragment_sets$fragment_set_area_um2[match(fragment_2, fragment_sets$name)],
            similarity = similarity_function(area1, area2),
            duplicates = similarity >= similarity_threshold
      )
        
        # Create a data frame of fragments involved:
        fragments_in_compare <- comparison_df %>%
          # For fragment_1 side
          transmute(
            fragment = fragment_1,
            duplicates = duplicates,
            is_smaller_dup = ifelse(duplicates & area1 < area2, TRUE, FALSE)) %>%
          bind_rows(
            # For fragment_2 side
            comparison_df %>%
              transmute(
                fragment = fragment_2,
                duplicates = duplicates,
                is_smaller_dup = ifelse(duplicates & area2 < area1, TRUE, FALSE)))
        
        fragment_summary <- fragments_in_compare %>%
          group_by(fragment) %>%
          summarize(
            # Does this fragment appear in any duplicates?
            any_duplicates = any(duplicates, na.rm = TRUE),
            # Is the fragment ever the smaller one in a duplicate pair?
            any_smaller = any(is_smaller_dup, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
          mutate(include = ifelse(any_smaller, FALSE, TRUE))
        
        fragment_sets <- fragment_sets %>%
          left_join(fragment_summary, by = c("name" = "fragment")) %>%
          
          # Fragments that never appeared in a duplicate comparison will have NA in include
          mutate(include = ifelse(is.na(include), TRUE, include)) %>%
          mutate(classification = ifelse(include, "include_set", "exclude_set"))
      }
    #classify fragments based on inclusion
    include_sets <- fragment_sets %>%
      filter(classification == "include_set")
    
    fragments <- fragments %>%
      mutate(
        overlaps_include = lengths(st_intersects(geometry, include_sets)) > 0,
        included = overlaps_include,
        exclusion_reason = ifelse(!included, "duplicate", NA_character_),
        classification = ifelse(included, "original_fragment", "duplicate_fragment")) %>%
      select(-overlaps_include)
    
    if (!all(st_is_valid(fragments))) {
      warning("Some fragments still invalid on ", image_name, 
              "; attempting auto-repair before writing.")
      fragments <- st_make_valid(fragments)
      }
    
    file_name_fragments <- paste0(fragment_dir, image_name, "_fragments.geojson")
    st_write(fragments, file_name_fragments, driver = "GeoJSON", delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
    
    fragments_metadata_slide <- fragments %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      rename(fragment_name = name) %>%
      select(image_name, fragment_name, classification, fragment_area_px2, fragment_area_um2)
    
    log_meta(fragments_metadata_slide)
    
  }
  
  return(subset_fragment_metadata)
  
}


```

### Analyze labl_2020_training

#### Input
- subset_labl_2020_training.json (fe_si_images/output/process_subset/)

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
subset_labl_2020_training <- fromJSON("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_images/output/process_subset/subset_labl_2020_training.json")


tissue_dir <- paste0(to_box, "judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/tissue_vs_glass/output/export_tissue/")

fragment_dir <- paste0(to_box, "judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragments/output/fragments/")


template <- generate_fragments(subset_labl_2020_training, tissue_dir, fragment_dir)

write_json(template, paste0(fragment_dir, "fragment_metadata_labl_2020_training.json"))

all_fragment_metadata <- fromJSON("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragments/output/fragments/fragments_metadata.json")

all_fragment_metadata <- bind_rows(all_fragment_metadata, template)

write_json(all_fragment_metadata, paste0(fragment_dir, "fragments_metadata.json"))
```

### Analyze grading_sample (batch 0) (for fe_si_papers/lymphocyte_distribution_patterns...)

#### Input
- fragments_metadata.json (fe_si_models/fragments/output/fragments)
file to keep track of all previously processed fragments
- subset_<subset_name>.json (fe_si_images/output/process_subset/)
- <image>_tissue_1.geojson (fe_si_models/tissue_vs_glass/output/export_tissue/)

#### Output
- <image_name>_fragments.geojson (fe_si_models/fragments/output/fragments)
with fragment coordinates
- fragment_metadata_<subset>.json (fe_si_models/fragments/output/fragments)
- template_fragments_<subset>.json (fe_si_models/fragments/output/fragments)
for human-in-the-loop to correct duplicates and mark fragments for exclusion
- <subset>_processed_fragments.txt (fe_si_models/fragments/output/fragments)
to read into qupath for human-in-the-loop assessment
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

#all previously processed grading_samples
all_fragment_metadata <- fromJSON(paste0(to_box, "judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragments/output/fragments/fragments_metadata.json"))

subset_name <- "grading_sample"

subset <- fromJSON(paste0(to_box, "judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_images/output/process_subset/subset_", subset_name, ".json"))

subset_image_names <- subset$image_name

fragment_dir <- paste0(to_box, "judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragments/output/fragments/")

processed_files <- list.files(path = fragment_dir, full.names = FALSE)

unprocessed_images <- subset_image_names[
  !vapply(subset_image_names, function(x) any(startsWith(processed_files, x)), logical(1))
]

tissue_dir <- paste0(to_box, "judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/tissue_vs_glass/output/export_tissue/")

available_tissue <- list.files(path = tissue_dir, full.names = FALSE)

unprocessed_available_tissue_images <- unprocessed_images[
  vapply(unprocessed_images, function(x) any(startsWith(available_tissue, x)), logical(1))
]

subset_to_process <- subset %>% filter(image_name %in% unprocessed_available_tissue_images)
template <- generate_fragments(subset_to_process, tissue_dir, fragment_dir)

all_fragment_metadata <- bind_rows(all_fragment_metadata, template)

write_json(all_fragment_metadata, paste0(fragment_dir, "fragments_metadata.json"))

fragment_metadata <- all_fragment_metadata %>%
  filter(image_name %in% subset_image_names) %>%
  arrange(match(image_name, subset_image_names))

write_json(fragment_metadata, paste0(fragment_dir, "fragment_metadata_", subset_name, ".json"), pretty = TRUE)

fragment_template <- fragment_metadata %>% 
  select(image_name, fragment_name, classification) %>%
  mutate(corrected_classification = "",
         exclude = "",
         exclusion_reason = "")

write_xlsx(fragment_template, paste0(fragment_dir, "template_fragments_",subset_name,".xlsx"))

filtered <- subset %>% filter(image_name %in% fragment_metadata$image_name)

file_paths_for_qupath <- filtered$file_path

writeLines(file_paths_for_qupath, paste0(fragment_dir, subset_name, "_processed_fragments.txt"))
```

### Analyze batch_1 (for fe_si_papers/lymphocyte_distribution_patterns...)

#### Input
- fragments_metadata.json (fe_si_models/fragments/output/fragments)
file to keep track of all previously processed fragments
- subset_<subset_name>.json (fe_si_images/output/process_subset/)
- <image>_tissue_1.geojson (fe_si_models/tissue_vs_glass/output/export_tissue/)

#### Output
- <image_name>_fragments.geojson (fe_si_models/fragments/output/fragments)
with fragment coordinates
- fragment_metadata_<subset>.json (fe_si_models/fragments/output/fragments)
- template_fragments_<subset>.json (fe_si_models/fragments/output/fragments)
for human-in-the-loop to correct duplicates and mark fragments for exclusion
- <subset>_processed_fragments.txt (fe_si_models/fragments/output/fragments)
to read into qupath for human-in-the-loop assessment
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

#all previously processed grading_samples
all_fragment_metadata <- fromJSON(paste0(to_box, "judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragments/output/fragments/fragments_metadata.json"))


subset_name <- "batch_1"

subset <- fromJSON(paste0(to_box, "judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_images/output/process_subset/subset_", subset_name, ".json"))

subset_image_names <- subset$image_name

fragment_dir <- paste0(to_box, "judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragments/output/fragments/")

processed_files <- list.files(path = fragment_dir, full.names = FALSE)

unprocessed_images <- subset_image_names[
  !vapply(subset_image_names, function(x) any(startsWith(processed_files, x)), logical(1))
]

tissue_dir <- paste0(to_box, "judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/tissues/output/export_tissue/")

available_tissue <- list.files(path = tissue_dir, full.names = FALSE)

unprocessed_available_tissue_images <- unprocessed_images[
  vapply(unprocessed_images, function(x) any(startsWith(available_tissue, x)), logical(1))
]

subset_to_process <- subset %>% filter(image_name %in% unprocessed_available_tissue_images)


template <- generate_fragments(subset_to_process, tissue_dir, fragment_dir)


write_json(template, paste0(fragment_dir, "fragment_metadata_batch_1.json"), pretty = TRUE)

fragment_template <- template %>% 
  select(image_name, fragment_name, classification) %>%
```
